instruction: Calculate total exposure for US Treasury bonds
output: SELECT SUM(total_exposure) AS us_treasury_exposure FROM `investment-treasury-ai.dbt_dev_analytics.fct_liquidity_summary` WHERE asset_class = 'US_TREASURY';

instruction: List all asset classes with exposure over 10 million
output: SELECT asset_class, SUM(total_exposure) AS total_val FROM `investment-treasury-ai.dbt_dev_analytics.fct_liquidity_summary` GROUP BY asset_class HAVING total_val > 10000000;
